question:
**Direction: The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

There are some venmous snakes which spit and hiss when they are cornered.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Venomous."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the misspelt word is **Venomous**.
 
• The word **'venomous'** means poisonous and is used to describe animals that can inject venom into their prey or attackers. (विषैला, ज़हरीला)
 
 
• **Example**: *She found a highly **venomous**__ black widow spider in a bunch of grapes.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
